_meta.range: kalan 49 kelime — C2 ve sözlüğün tamamı bitiyor

tantalize--verb.def: To tempt someone with what they cannot have.
tantalize--verb.ex: The smell tantalized the waiting children.

tantalizingly--adv.def: In a way that keeps something desirable just out of reach.

taste-maker--noun.def: A person whose choices shape what others admire.
taste-maker--noun.ex: A few taste-makers decide the season.
taste-maker--noun.exTr: Sezonu birkaç zevk belirleyici tayin ediyor.

teem--verb.def: To be full of moving people or animals.

telescopic--adj.def: Made of parts that slide into each other, or used for distant viewing.

telescopically--adv.def: By sliding parts into one another, or through a telescope.

tenaciously--adv.def: In a way that holds on and refuses to give up.

tetchy--adj.ex: He gets tetchy when he is hungry.

timidity--noun.def: A lack of courage or confidence.

topographical--adj.def: Relating to the shape and features of the land.

topographically--adv.def: In terms of the surface features of land.

totemic--adj.def: Treated as a powerful symbol by a group.
totemic--adj.ex: The bridge is totemic for the city.
totemic--adj.exTr: Köprü kent için simgesel bir değer.

totter--verb.def: To walk or stand unsteadily, as if about to fall.
totter--verb.ex: The old wall tottered in the wind.

tranquilize--verb.def: To make a person or animal calm with a drug.

treacherously--adv.def: In a disloyal way, or in a way full of hidden danger.
treacherously--adv.exTr: Buz ayaklarının altında tehlikeli biçimde çatladı.

truism--noun.def: A statement so obviously true that it adds nothing.
truism--noun.ex: It is a truism that markets move.

undemonstrative--adj.ex: Her father was kind but undemonstrative.
undemonstrative--adj.exTr: Babası iyi kalpli ama duygularını belli etmeyen biriydi.

undemonstratively--adv.def: Without any open show of feeling.

undiminishing--adj.def: Continuing at full strength without weakening.

unencumbered--adj.def: Free of anything that weighs you down or limits you.

unexceptional--adj.def: Ordinary and not unusual in any way.
unexceptional--adj.ex: The meal was pleasant but unexceptional.

unexceptionally--adv.def: In a way that stands out in no respect.

unexcused--adj.def: Without an accepted reason or permission.

unfeasible--adj.def: Impossible to carry out in practice.

unfeasibly--adv.def: To a degree that seems impossible.

unharried--adj.def: Not rushed or troubled by pressure.

unmediated--adj.def: Direct, with nothing standing in between.

unnerve--verb.def: To make someone lose confidence or feel uneasy.

unnervingly--adv.def: In a way that makes you uneasy.

unobtrusive--adj.ex: The cameras are small and unobtrusive.

unobtrusively--adv.def: In a way that draws no attention.

unobtrusiveness--noun.def: The quality of not drawing attention.
unobtrusiveness--noun.ex: The design is praised for its unobtrusiveness.

unpromising--adj.def: Unlikely to lead to a good result.
unpromising--adj.exTr: Sezon umut vaat etmeyen bir başlangıç yaptı.

unsurpassed--adj.def: Better than anything else of its kind.

unsuspected--adj.def: Existing without anyone knowing or guessing.
unsuspected--adj.exTr: Rapor akla gelmeyen zararları ortaya çıkardı.

utilitarian--adj.def: Made for use rather than beauty.
utilitarian--adj.ex: The furniture is plain and utilitarian.

utilization--noun.def: The act of putting something to practical use.

vandalize--verb.def: To damage property deliberately and pointlessly.

verisimilitude--noun.def: The appearance of being true or real.

vestigial--adj.def: Remaining only as a small trace of something once larger.

vestigially--adv.def: Only as a small surviving trace.

vindicate--verb.def: To prove that someone was right or free of blame.

voracity--noun.def: A greedy eagerness for food or for anything.

wistfully--adv.def: With a sad longing for something out of reach.
wistfully--adv.ex: She looked wistfully at the sea.

wordage--noun.def: The number of words used, or words seen as excessive.
wordage--noun.ex: Cut the wordage by a third.

wordsmith--noun.def: A person skilled at choosing and arranging words.
wordsmith--noun.exTr: Konuşmanın bir kalem ustasına ihtiyacı vardı.

wrack--verb.def: To damage or torment something severely.
wrack--verb.ex: Storms wracked the coast all winter.
wrack--verb.exTr: Fırtınalar bütün kış kıyıyı kasıp kavurdu.
